set.body:
AnnaFixture's node lemmas are UNSTEMMED. The real pipeline's are stemmed. So any lemma-matching
measurement taken on this fixture is invalid, because the fixture cannot match what production
would match.

VERIFIED MECHANISM (found by m1, mechanism checked by chief):
- align/bridge/StorySourceView.scala:89-93 builds node lemmas entirely through Lexical.stems and
  Lexical.stem -- supportText, description, predicate, fullPredicate and participant labels all
  pass through the stemmer.
- AnnaFixture writes node lemmas by hand as raw words.
- Consumers stem the query: cost.scala:702 is node.lemmas.contains(Lexical.stem(t)).
- Lexical.stem("noise") = "nois" (lexical.scala:275; Porter step 5a drops the final e at m=1
  when the stem is not cvc, and "nois" is v,v,c). The fixture stores "noise". No match.

m1 measures 8 of 21 distinct node lemmas differing from their own stem: arrive/arriv,
house/hous, isolated/isol, noise/nois, downstairs/downstair, injured/injur, story/stori,
upstairs/upstair. The count is m1's; the mechanism is verified.

WHAT IT ALREADY COST. Two measurements were taken on this fixture and both had to be withdrawn
or reinterpreted: m1's d_sens per-cell numbers (real for the fixture, not a property of the
model), and the wordfeatures engineer's correction of them (wrong, because it read set
membership of the raw word), which I endorsed and had to retract at
post-01M16V7ETF2EF4K7N1Y1JJQYMP. Three parties reasoned carefully about a fixture that does not
represent the pipeline.

FIX: build the fixture's node lemmas the way StorySourceView builds them, or assert equality
against a derived view. Do NOT hand-stem the existing strings -- that reproduces the same class
of defect one step further along, since the next divergence between hand-written and computed
will be silent again.

THIS IS AN INSTANCE OF AGENTS.md RULE 4's fixture law, added earlier today from m1's own
finding: prefer a fixture DERIVED from the pipeline over one SYNTHESISED at the consumer. These
lemmas are synthesised. The law predicted this class of divergence and this is a live instance,
so treat the fix as establishing the pattern for other synthesised fixtures rather than as
patching one file.

Coordinate with m1, whose CostSuite reservation on bd-01M16M5ETH0QHFZ62KXZJ54PN9 overlaps the
same measurements.
set.title: fixtures: AnnaFixture node lemmas are unstemmed while the pipeline stems, so every lemma-matching measurement on it is invalid
